name: What is the difference between commercial and residential flooring?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between commercial and residential flooring?

acceptedAnswer.text: Commercial flooring is engineered to withstand significantly higher traffic, heavier loads, and more rigorous use than residential flooring. It typically features greater durability, enhanced slip resistance, and often meets specific fire safety or sanitation codes relevant to commercial environments. Residential flooring, while aesthetically pleasing, prioritizes comfort and home-specific designs over the extreme wear resistance required in businesses. Materials like certain LVT, polished concrete, and industrial-grade carpet tiles are specifically designed for the demands of commercial settings, ensuring longevity and performance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Commercial flooring is designed for high traffic and heavy use, offering greater durability and meeting specific codes, unlike residential flooring which prioritizes comfort and aesthetics.
